articles.summary: ATLANTA and PITTSBURGH, Aug. 26, 2026 — Norfolk Southern Corporation (NYSE: NSC) and Wabtec Corporation (NYSE: WAB) today announced an expanded program to modernize 33 DC-traction Evolution Series locomotives for the railroad. As part of Norfolk Southern's fleet modernization strategy, the initiative will convert the units to AC-traction technology to improve performance, reliability, and efficiency.
articles.title: Norfolk Southern and Wabtec Expand Locomotive Modernization Program
